prompt: Find the top 3 flows by attributed revenue from the last 30 days. You will need to list flows and pull flow value reports for each. Put the answer inside `final_answer` as a JSON array of exactly 3 objects, each with fields: name, revenue. Order by revenue descending.

claims.description: each item has name and revenue

notes: Hits flow-values-reports endpoint — same throttling tier as campaign reports.
